master.prompt: Olive 6x4 heavy duty log truck with THREE truck axles and small folded log-loader crane behind cab. Long cedar logs on bunks with stakes and chains running back onto TWO-axle pole log trailer. Entire 17m rig in one very wide image. Work-worn paint and dried mud. Exactly FIVE fully visible identical 1.19m mud-terrain tires, deep chunky lugs. No mixer drum. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout: dark readable contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, rich natural texture, soft even daylight. Facing right. True transparent background, no halo, ground, shadow, text, logos or watermark. Full object with generous clear margins. PNG at least 1500px long side. Orthographic side elevation, no cab front visible, round equal tires and centred rims, hubs aligned horizontally, horizontal chassis and log stack. Wide 3000x1000 canvas. CRITICAL: ONE continuous bundle of 16 metre long cedar logs extends uninterrupted from immediately behind the cab all the way to the rear trailer stakes. NO separate log bundles, NO gap in logs. Pole logging trailer is only rear wheel bogie and a long narrow connecting pole beneath the continuous logs. Vehicle occupies 90 percent of canvas width, 5 percent clear transparent margin each side.

body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit cedar-hauler-7's own vehicle-master-v1.png; canvas EXACTLY 2172x724 pixels. Remove ALL FIVE road tires/rims: two trailer road wheels at left, two truck rear, one steering at right. Preserve all logs, stakes, chains, logging crane and olive cab. Remove all road rubber tires and rims COMPLETELY. Paint OPAQUE wheel-well interiors across the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of each original tire circle from fender lip to ORIGINAL HUB LINE, full arch width: dark solid metal inner fender liners with chassis rails, small axle housings, leaf or coil springs, shocks, air lines and mud flaps in the same weathered painted style. NO transparent holes above hub line. Fill gaps between tandem arches down to original hub line too. Background must not show when separate tire drops a third radius. Below hub line leave lower half of each removed tire circle transparent; preserve transparent open ground clearance under chassis. No tire tread, rims, discs, full black wheel circles, ghosts or far tires. Change NOTHING ELSE: all load, cab, equipment, spare and non-wheel-region pixels untouched. Exact same canvas size, position, scale, camera, clear margins. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, readable dark contours, weathered materials and fine mechanical detail, soft even light. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, halo, ground, shadow, added text or watermark. Return ONLY the edited PNG at the exact original dimensions.
